note: Re-derived by hand from the page snapshot during adversarial review. The introducing sentence is "You can log network activity events for the following services:" (line 8). The counted list runs from line 9 to line 72 and holds exactly 62 top-level '+ ' bullets; lines 58-59 are an inline **Note** inside the list, not bullets, and line 73 is the blank line that ends it. Everything from line 74 onward is a Contents navigation block, configuration guidance, and example JSON event selectors and event records; the services, API operations and JSON keys named there are illustrations, not coverage, and are not counted. All 62 bullets resolve to a distinct real IAM service, so numerator = 62 and unresolved = 0 (62 + 0 = 62 bullets). Five bullets do not resolve correctly through the services.json name index and are settled by the page's own eventSource principal instead: 'Billing and Cost Management' -> billing (services.json wrongly aliases it to budgets; the page's principal is billing.amazonaws.com), 'AWS Data Exports' -> bcm-data-exports (services.json wrongly aliases it to cur; the page's principal is bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com), 'Amazon Lookout for Vision' -> lookoutvision (the only row publishing that name is product:amazon-lookout-for-vision, a products-directory row with no IAM prefix, which the contract bans; the page's principal is lookoutvision.amazonaws.com), 'AWS CloudHSM' -> cloudhsm (the name is shared by cloudhsm and cloudhsmv2; the page's principal is cloudhsm.amazonaws.com), 'AWS Pricing Calculator' -> bcm-pricing-calculator (no services.json row publishes the name; the page's principal is bcm-pricing-calculator.amazonaws.com). Amazon S3 carries an inline Note saying Multi-Region Access Points are not supported, so S3 is the only partial; no other carve-out appears inside the list. The separate eventSource valid-values list (76 service principals, lines 108-183) is a field's valid-values enumeration, not the page's coverage sentence, and is not counted; on the service axis it resolves to 71 distinct ids and the union with the bullet list would be 77.
